dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Congenital unilateral upper eyelid retraction (idiopathic, isolated levator palpebrae superioris overaction)

Alternatives I would still consider:
1. Mild or forme fruste Graves' ophthalmopathy with negative serology (could revisit if any future thyroid antibody positivity or subclinical change)
2. Aberrant third nerve regeneration following an unrecognized childhood third nerve palsy (consider if pupillary or motility abnormalities emerge)
3. Localized congenital cranial dysinnervation disorder of the superior division of the oculomotor nerve (would only be settled by long-term follow-up)
